title: Dr. STONE
description: Doctor StoneOne fateful day, all of humanity was petrified by a blinding flash of light. After several millennia, high schooler Taiju awakens and finds himself lost in a world of statues. However, he’s not alone! His science-loving friend Senku’s been up and running for a few months and he’s got a grand plan in mind, to kickstart civilization with the power of science!

S1-E7Where Two Million Years Have Gone
S1-E9Let There Be the Light of Science

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Several thousand years after a mysterious phenomenon  turns all of humanity to stone, the extraordinarily intelligent, science-driven boy, Senku Ishigami, awakens from petrification. Facing a world of stone and the total collapse of civilization, Senku makes up his mind to use science to rebuild the world. Starting with his super strong childhood friend Taiju Oki, who awakened at the same time, they will begin to rebuild civilization from nothing. Depicting two million years of scientific history from the Stone Age to present day, the unprecedented crafting adventure story is about to begin.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Facing immediate danger from wild animals Senku and Taiju are forced to revive Tsukasa Shishio "The Strongest High School Primate". Although Tsukasa has tremendous fighting ability and provides abundant food as their hunter, their new ally harbors an opposing view on restoring humanity.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Senku does not trust the motivation of Shishio, so he will try to hide his plans from a new and unforeseen enemy for his plan to revive civilization.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Senku has the idea of ​​creating gunpowder to have a way to balance the scale and have a chance to defeat Shishio. The production of gunpowder causes a fire. Shortly thereafter, Senku and the others discover smoke signals on the horizon. An accident? Hardly likely. Apparently there are other people in the stone world ...

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Shishio is determined to end Senku's life if he does not promise at that moment that he will abandon his idea of ​​recovering civilization as it was before the incident.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Taiju and Yuzuriha figure out Senku's secret to reviving him. But now that he's back, they need to deal with Tsukasa.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Kohaku shows Senku to her village, but it's going to take some convincing before they let him in. In the meantime, he makes friends with a like-minded, promising "sorcerer."

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Kohaku's sister, village priestess Ruri, is gravely ill. Senku, Chrome and Kohaku begin their quest to make antibiotics to save her life.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Senku starts a ramen stand in hopes of winning over support for his kingdom of science, but some people are too principled to take such a bribe. Mentalist Asagiri Gen is not one of them.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Senku and his kingdom of science successfully test the first lightbulb since the collapse. Meanwhile, Asagiri Gen, a spy from Tsukasa's empire, is killed by an unknown attacker.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: The development of glassworks, an important step for making sulfa drugs and for chemistry as a whole, turns out to have a surprising benefit for Suika.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: To make antibiotics, Senku and his kingdom need to obtain sulfuric acid from a fountain of the stuff. The team goes prepared, but there's no guarantee that they'll make it back alive.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 1 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: All that's needed to make antibiotics is alcohol. The best way to get some is to win the Grand Bout, which the Senku and his kingdom will also need to do in order to keep Magma away from Ruri and give her the drug.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 1 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: After Magma's series of tricks to reach the final match, Chrome reveals a trick of his own! With a little extra help from Gen, Chrome just may be able to pull this one off!

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 1 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: After Senku's unlikely victory, quick marriage, and even hastier divorce, the kingdom of science is back to work to finally finish Ruri's medicine!

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 1 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: Ruri reveals the origin of the village's name and Senku learns of his father's fate!

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 1 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: Byakuya and the astronauts' story continues, and Senku's connection to Ishigami Village and the Hundred Tales is finally revealed.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 1 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: Tsukasa's army is coming! Kinro struggles to hold the bridge against the deadly spearman Hyoga and his shock troops, but Senku and the villagers are ready with deadly new weapons of science!

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 1 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: Hyoga is disarmed, but the kingdom of science is still in danger - Ishigami village is in flames! And Tsukasa will soon know that Senku is still alive... How will the villagers fight off the coming invasion?

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 1 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: Work begins on creating the components for Senku's cell phone, but spinning gold wire is proving to be quite the task! Luckily, Chrome and Kaseki "invent" the water wheel and drastically improve the process!

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 1 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: With Chrome and Kaseki’s water wheel finished, Ishigami Village moves into the age of electricity! But with the primitive materials available to him, will Senku be able to create a filament that can withstand the intense heat of operating a vacuum tube?

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 1 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: Senku, Chrome, and Magma venture into a cave in search of Tungsten, but there's a suspicious accident that leaves Senku and Chrome trapped at the bottom of a pit! What is Magma up to?!

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 1 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: Senku and the rest of the village get to work on making the components for the cell phone. It's hard work but everyone is pumped!

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 1 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: After a successful test of their new cell phone, Senku learns of a mysterious tale about a bee named Speaker who can play the voices of the dead.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 2 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Senku continues in trying to advance the Stone World, this time he makes "space food", it is in actuality cup noodles. After Senku finishes his project, Gen has an epiphany and devises a plan to take down Tsukasa's army without violence.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 2 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: While Senku's diversion buys Gen and others some time, soon Homura realizes something is not right.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 2 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Taiju and Yuzuriha are on the verge of tears after they hear Senku's voice, and Senku informs them of his plan to win the war without any bloodshed.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 2 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Chrome and Magma struggle with Ukyo, while Senku, gets his hands busy with building up an invention; a new hope.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 2 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: The final touches to the automobile are made and it is used to transport the science supplies to a fortified cliffside that's close to the Tsukasa empire. From there the automobile is upgraded into a tank, but unbeknownst to the rescue group preparations by the empire have been made to counter any vehicular attack.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 2 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Chrome must use all of his scientific knowledge to escape from his prison and save Senku and others.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 2 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Senku decides to use the Steam-Gorilla to capture The Miracle Cave. Using Lillian's recording, Senku gains the trust of more of Tsukasa's men. Ukyo reveals he saw Yuzuriha's secret mission to reassemble the fragments of statues Tsukasa destroyed.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 2 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: The Final Battle for the miracle cave starts as Senku and the Kingdom of Science conduct a frontal assault on the cave.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 2 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Senku demands a truce from Tsukasa in return for reviving his sister, Mirai, who Tsukasa comes to know is alive, but a new problem shows us when Hyoga shows his true self.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 2 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Senku demands a truce from Tsukasa in return for reviving his sister, Mirai, who Tsukasa comes to know is alive, but a new problem shows up when Hyoga shows his true self.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 2 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: The Kingdom of Science is victorious, however it is not over for Senku. Senku must use all of his knowledge to cure Tsukasa who is severly injured.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 3 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: While continuing to use the hot air balloon to search for the oil, it's decided that Ishigami Village needs to take up agriculture to prevent future food shortages, as well as to produce preserved food for their upcoming sea voyage.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 3 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: The Kingdom of Science will need rations to last them through their voyage to the other side of the world. But Senku, being no professional, burns all the bread he attempts to bake.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 3 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Senku, brings along a team to look for the Sagara Oil Fields. Meanwhile, Suika and Francois go truffle hunting.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 3 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: The morse code signal reading "WHY" saturates the airwaves too much for Ukyo to pinpoint a direction, so the Kingdom of Science works on a way to visualize the signal.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 3 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Kaseki's efforts to build the science vessel Perseus hit a roadblock when he realizes that it's impossible to get all the parts to fit in practice.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 3 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: The Perseus crew are on their way to the treasure island, the birthplace of the Hundred Tales, where they hope to locate the treasure box left behind by the Soyuz crew.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 3 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: The Perseus arrives at the treasure island. A recon squad consisting of Senku, Soyuz, Kohaku, and Gen set off to locate the platinum and make contact with the islanders. Ukyo later discovers something on the seafloor and send Ginro to investigate.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 3 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Amaryllis explains how she evaded petrification and how she came to her decision to sneak into the inner palace.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 3 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Suika and Ginro work together to rescue the mobile lab from the Perseus. Reunited with Senku and the others, the group works on items to help Kohaku with the selection process.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 3 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Amaryllis, Ginro and Kohaku are chosen to join the inner palace. The science team will need a way to communicate with them in secret, and, eventually, a way for them with the science team.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 3 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Kohaku has located the treasure left behind by Byakuya and the others, but it's encased in concrete. Senku has to devise a plan to quietly get at the contents inside, so as to not alert the guards.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 3 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Kohaku is forced to destroy Ryusui's statue to prove that she isn't a spy.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 3 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: The team revives Kaseki to work on the drone. Meanwhile, Ginro is called to see the Master.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 3 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: More of the Kingdom of Science is brought back from petrification, but they are discovered in the cave by Moz.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 3 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: Moz and the Kingdom of Science form a tenuous, temporary alliance against Ibara. How long it will last is a question they can't afford to concern themselves with just yet.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 3 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: The Kingdom of Science attacks and tries to execute their plan to steal the petrification device. Moz convinces Kirisame to use the device, but Ryusui's instincts tell him something is off about the situation.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 3 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: The Kingdom of Science members launch an attack on the islanders aboard the Perseus, but Moz isn't far behind and Senku and the others are forced to retreat inside the vessel. Ibara has them cornered, but Senku unleashes his Joker card.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 3 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: Yo and the Kingdom of Science capture the petrification device, but Ibara isn't going down without a fight.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 3 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: Much to Ibara's shock and dismay, Senku devised a plan and managed to escape petrification. Now the two enter into a head-to-head battle for control of the Medusa device.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 3 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: Senku stands victorious. He then works on reviving the others and fixing their communications device, but while they are talking with Ruri they encounter a strong interference with the signal.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 3 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: To the moon! That's the plan, at least. Senku and the Kingdom of Science need to devise a means with which to go to the moon and deal with Why-Man. The first step is allying with the people of Treasure Island and enlisting their help with some new crafts.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 3 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: With the petrification device in the Kingdom's hands, it's time to revive Tsukasa. But there's just one problem: the device is out of batteries.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 4 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Senku and his companions finally set off for America in search of corn. However, a dispute arises between Ryusui and Senku shortly after they depart.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 4 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Maintaining morale will be critical on the long journey to the Americas. Knowing where on the ocean you are is pretty important, too. The crew of the Perseus discuss.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 4 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: The Perseus lands in the Americas. They first head to Northern California in search of yellow dent corn, but discover a lot more than that.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 4 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: The search party narrowly escaped enemy machine gun fire. Unfortunately, the respite was short-lived.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 4 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Tensions rise as Dr. Xeno makes his introductions to the Perseus.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 4 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Senku had gotten his start in rocket building through an email exchange with Doctor Xeno. Their approaches to science soon diverged.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 4 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: With Senku having been shot, the Kingdom of Science plots its retaliation against Dr. Xeno.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 4 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: With Senku still confined to the bed, Chrome's team begins work on the tunnel to Xeno's base.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 4 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: The team head to the source of the petrification beam in South America as they flee from Stanley's ship.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 4 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: Senku and company must flee from Stanley's ship, but they have to make stops to refuel.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 4 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: The team is going to need a weapon for when Stanley inevitably catches up to them.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 4 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: Senku and his team have lost Stanley for now, but they aren't out of — or rather, in — the woods just yet.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 4 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: The team discovers a giant pile of petrification devices. They take them apart to see what makes them tick.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 4 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: The team begins making, digging for, and polishing diamonds to replace the burnt-out ones inside the devices.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 4 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: Suika is in charge of making sure Senku's plan works, but her kindness becomes an obstacle.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 4 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: With the revival team captured, it's up to Luna and Chelsea to revive everyone when the time comes.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 4 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: With the petrification beam approaching, who will get their hands on the revival fluid?

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 4 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: Suika gathers the team's statues, sets up camp and gets to work doing science.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 4 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: With Senku back, it's only a matter of time before the rest of the Kingdom of Science is revived.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 4 Episode 25
episodes_data.description: Senku and Dr. Xeno team up to gather the materials needed to make a rocket engine.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 4 Episode 26
episodes_data.description: The crew arrives in Spain, where they collect fluorite, olive oil and some treats.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 4 Episode 27
episodes_data.description: The New Perseus sets out to India to recruit mathematicians for the space program.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 4 Episode 29
episodes_data.description: The team gets to work wiring up several megabits' worth of memory donuts for their computer.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 4 Episode 30
episodes_data.description: The team will need a stupidly insane amount of electricity to turn their bauxite into an aluminum rocket body.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 4 Episode 31
episodes_data.description: With the computer completed, the team will need a user interface: a TV.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 4 Episode 32
episodes_data.description: The Kingdom of Science's rocket launches are mired by a string of rapid unscheduled disassemblies.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 4 Episode 33
episodes_data.description: The team is too small to build a round-trip rocket. They'll need to enlist help from around the world.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 4 Episode 34
episodes_data.description: Ryusui may need to defer to a better pilot for the moon mission.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 4 Episode 35
episodes_data.description: The rocket needs to be assembled in space. Not an easy feat in the 21st century, let alone in the stone world.

episodes_data.title: Dr. STONE Season 4 Episode 36
episodes_data.description: The team sets foot on the moon to confront Why-Man.
